facts.value: The 1.0F literal supplies the default mobility multiplier and animation playback speed. The 0.0F literal supplies animation start frame, the standard wrapper animation blend, and initial persistent directional blend. Mobility is scaled by air_drift_max; the caller-supplied blend of ftCo_800969D8 is passed directly as anim_blend, not as the starting frame.
facts.rationale: Correct the optional starting-frame description; the argument is animation blend.

facts.value: An eight-byte .sdata2 literal pool containing big-endian f32 values 1.0F then 0.0F, bytes 3f80000000000000 in both existing objects. Split-object section flags are SHF_ALLOC; source-object flags are SHF_ALLOC|SHF_WRITE. Reviewed code loads the literals without writing the pool.
facts.rationale: Separate load-only literal use from differing split/source ELF permissions; see data-corroboration.json.

facts.value: Provides the one-argument default FallSpecial entry. It forwards xC=1, x10=0, landing allow_interrupt=true, mobility multiplier 1 and Fighter.x2EC as landing lag to the standard jump-consuming entry path. The interrupt flag is used by the eventual landing state, not as a gate on FallSpecial IASA.
facts.rationale: Distinguish stored landing interrupt policy from the independently executed aerial IASA checks.

facts.value: Enters configurable FallSpecial with caller-supplied animation blend, mobility multiplier, landing lag and policy selectors. Already-airborne entrants retain their current jump-use count in this variant; grounded entrants pass through common airborne setup that assigns jumpsUsed=max_jumps.
facts.rationale: Grounded entry consumes jumps; preservation applies only to already-airborne entrants.

facts.value: If x2224_b2 is set, entry delegates to ftCo_80090780 without initializing FallSpecial. Otherwise it enters FallSpecial with KeepFastFall, frame zero, speed one and caller-supplied blend, then stores move policy and initializes directional blend. A grounded entrant becomes airborne with all jumps used; an already-airborne entrant keeps its prior jump-use count. The reviewed Ness aerial completion and rebound paths consume jumps before calling this wrapper when animation ends and configured landing lag is nonzero.
facts.rationale: Correct unconditional jump-preservation wording and distinguish caller-side jump consumption in all reviewed Ness completion paths.

facts.value: Entry stores scaled mobility, physics selector xC, forced-special-landing selector x10, landing lag and landing interrupt policy. Caller-supplied animation blend is passed to Fighter_ChangeMotionState; the separate directional blend x4 starts at zero. Physics reads xC and mobility; landing reads x10, lag and interrupt policy. IASA and platform filtering use their own helper guards and input, not those stored entry policies.
facts.rationale: Correct blend storage and overbroad claims that entry policy feeds aerial IASA and platform filtering.

facts.value: The x2224_b2 guard diverts to ftCo_80090780. Normal entry keeps fast-fall, initializes policy and consumes jumps except for already-airborne entrants through the blend variant. IASA runs three ordered exception checks. Physics caps target horizontal velocity only when xC is zero. Accepted contact selects LandingFallSpecial when x10 is set regardless of vertical velocity, or when vertical velocity is below the fighter-dependent threshold; otherwise it dispatches ft_8008A2BC.
facts.rationale: Preserve physics branch distinction and remove the false requirement that all special landings are descending.
